newsitem.title: USA: Titan Exploration has trouble with well.
newsitem.headline: Titan Exploration has trouble with well.

text.p: Titan Exploration Inc said Tuesday it was having trouble completing a well that it had begun drilling in January.
The company said "unanticipated water communication" was preventing it from completing the Miller 1 Fusselman well in Barstow Field in Ward County, Texas.
"However, there is evidence of Atoka pay at approximately 15,600'," it said.
The company, which owns 80 percent of the well, did not elaborate on the problem and its officials were not immediately available for comment.
It also said it foresaw average production reaching about 13,400 barrels of oil equivalent per day during the first quarter ended March 31, compared to 9,100 at the end of 1996.

"(The company) expects the first quarter exit rate to approximate 14,000 (barrels of oil equivalent)," it added. The company reported a net profit of $800,000 for the fourth quarter against a loss of $1.6 million a year ago.
It said the rise in earnings was due to production from property acquisitions.
